gratitude.title: Start with one grateful thought
gratitude.content: Write a small moment you appreciate today.

visibility.title: Choose who can see it
visibility.content: Private keeps this note only for you.

save.title: Save your first note
save.content: Your first saved entry completes onboarding.

filter.title: Choose your time range
filter.content: Switch between year, six months, month, or week to review your rhythm.

garden.title: Watch your garden grow
garden.content: Colors and symbols show how often you wrote on each day.

month.title: Explore a month
month.content: Move between months, then select a day to focus your view.

moments.title: Return to a day's moments
moments.content: Read the notes from the selected day, or add another moment.
